description: Show which SSH public keys can currently open a shell on this account's instances, with their fingerprints and when each was added. Use when the user asks what has access, before adding a key so you can say whether it is already there, or when they suspect a key they no longer recognise. Read-only and free. Registering a key is the step that grants shell access, so this is how you show what that has amounted to. Returns the key_id that delete_ssh_key needs — ids are not guessable, so revoking starts here.
name: list_ssh_keys
